findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Carnitas estilo Michoacán, recién salidas del ca" → 4 lines (7 words, 77.8px); "Ven con hambre, nosotros ponemos el cazo" → 3 lines (7 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "Desde 1974 hacemos carnitas al estilo Mi…" → 5 lines at 34.4px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 3 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Chuminópolis · Mérida · Desde 1974" above "Carnitas estilo Michoacán, recién salida"; "La cosa viva" above "Arma tu kilo"; "Reserva tu mesa" above "Ven con hambre, nosotros ponemos el cazo"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace, monospace — e.g. "$49", "$49", "$49", "$105"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 40 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Chuminópolis · Mérida · Desde 1974", "571 reseñas en Google", "Lunes, miércoles a domingo", "Y para llevar").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): section#reservas.seccion.seccion--reservas → radial-gradient(120% 90% at 100% 0%, rgba(217, 164, 65, 0.16), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 60%), none
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 5 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.boton.boton--primario → rgba(179, 38, 30, 0.25) 0px 8px 20px 0px | button#armador-anadir.boton.boton--primario → rgba(179, 38, 30, 0.25) 0px 8px 20px 0px | figure.cazo__foto → rgba(20, 11, 7, 0.06) 0px 1px 2px 0px, rgba(20, 11, 7, 0.18) 0px 10px 24px -12px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 3 text-shadow(s).
findings.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 39 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.cabecera 1440px | ul.hero__datos 676px | section#cazo.seccion.seccion--cazo 1440px | form#armador.armador 568px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 1 box(es) drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Prefer a filled surface or no box.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #fdf6ec, text #fdf6ec).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "El Rey" 1:1 (#fdf6ec on #fdf6ec); "Menú" 1:1 (#fdf6ec on #fdf6ec); "El cazo" 1:1 (#fdf6ec on #fdf6ec); "Galería" 1:1 (#fdf6ec on #fdf6ec)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (system-ui, ui-serif, ui-monospace).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 15.2px.
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.2:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 24 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Foto: Ferfive · CC BY 4.0 · Wi" (12px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 3 of 12 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 4, 5, 8.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.

findings.message: No headline found in the first viewport.
findings.fix: The first screen needs a clear focal statement or image.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 383px of the width empty: "Arma tu kilo".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: The h1 ("Carnitas estilo Michoacán, recién salidas del cazo") is not on the first screen (it starts 1103px down).
findings.fix: The title belongs on the first screen, where a visitor decides whether to stay.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Carnitas estilo Michoacán, recién salidas del ca" → 4 lines (7 words, 40px); "Ven con hambre, nosotros ponemos el cazo" → 3 lines (7 words, 30.4px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "Foto: Ferfive · CC BY 4.0 · Wi" (12px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.
